name: Lee Sang-min (이상민): 2021 solidarity tax bill
detail: The bill levies a temporary surcharge on income tax and corporate tax, not a tax on the stock of wealth. Reconsider only if independent qualifying evidence is found.

name: Thomas Piketty (토마 피케티)
detail: France-based economist speaking in Korea; the pre-PR checklist assigns overseas-based speakers to their home register.

name: Nam Dong-ho (남동호)
detail: 2020 leaflet labels the 90% measure a wealth tax but its explanation uses inheritance and gift tax brackets. Needs separate evidence of support for a qualifying wealth tax.
